Anti-drug activist shot dead by medical store owner in Punjab

Anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh alias Jhota was shot dead by a medical store owner in Mansa, Punjab. The incident occurred when Jhota was questioning the owner about the sale of certain drugs and recording the argument on his mobile phone. The shooting was captured on camera, with some reports indicating it happened during a Facebook Live session. Jhota had been campaigning against drug abuse in the area and would often confront alleged drug peddlers, sometimes recording these altercations. The killing has led to a political reaction, with the opposition alleging a failure of the state government.
